attributes.board_name: Junta Dental Examinadora de Puerto Rico (Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education; at least 16 hours in person, max 8 hours by module, journal or internet

topics.who: All licensees: 'Equidad y Respeto' course on bioethics and discrimination (Adm. Order 2024-583, since Jan 4, 2024)
CPR course (AHA or Asociación Puertorriqueña del Corazón)

rules.notes: Recertification under the Board's CE and registration regulation (Ley 11-1976); the period for hygienists is not stated on the sheet read (dentists: every 3 years). Includes a 3-hour CPR course (AHA or Asociación Puertorriqueña del Corazón).
rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 11 de 23 de junio de 1976; Reglamento 3692; Orden Administrativa 2024-583
